recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man with 1970s-style feathered hair, wearing a patterned blue button-down shirt, set against a backdrop of desert foliage under warm, golden-hour light. The composition features a prominent script title at the top and a small block of right-aligned text on the right side.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed away from the camera toward the left frame edge
Contrast between the intricate blue shirt pattern and the organic green spikes of the background plant
Warm backlighting creating a halo effect on the hair against a cooler-toned background
coreInvariants: Muted but rich color palette dominated by blue, ochre, and sage green
Top-aligned cursive display text with a subtle drop shadow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame in a medium shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes and the highlight on the forehead.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large script title at the top, moves down to the subject's face, follows his gaze to the left, then circles back to the small text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Upper corners and the area around the subject's head filled with out-of-focus desert plants.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Sage green and muted brown (background foliage)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm golden highlights on the hair and skin
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Medium saturation with a slightly faded, low-contrast vintage film aesthetic.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma modern colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with connected lowercase letters and flourishing capitals
letterConstructionRules: Monolinear stroke weight with slight variations
High slant angle to the right
Open loops in letters like 'l', 'e', and 'p'
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'G' and 'C' have large, circular flourishes
Lowercase 't' has a long, horizontal crossbar that connects to adjacent letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, fluid script for the primary name paired with a tiny, rigid sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Subtle drop shadow on main title to separate from busy background

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century casual script feel
Matches the utilitarian feel of the secondary text block

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s-style film photograph of a man with feathered brown hair looking off-camera. He wears a blue and white paisley patterned shirt. The background is a sun-drenched yucca plant with sharp green leaves. Use warm, golden-hour lighting and visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, cream-colored cursive title at the top center with a thin dark outline and soft drop shadow. Add a small, right-aligned list of text in a bold yellow sans-serif font on the right side of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the main title in a connected script?
Is the subject wearing a patterned blue shirt?
Is the lighting warm and evocative of the 1970s?
Is the secondary text block small and right-aligned?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure script flourishes do not obscure the face
Verify the right-aligned text is legible against the background
Confirm the color palette remains in the earthy/retro range
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 70s-style environmental portrait with top-aligned script and a side-aligned metadata block to create a vintage music aesthetic.
